_comment: Row 345. Run from a detached scratch repository with: venv/bin/python toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/row_345_opv_a11y_served_identity.json --work DETACHED_SCRATCH. The battery removes each independent discriminator: F4.3 auth restoration, the navigation-status gate, and cockpit identity. Its overcorrection also proves a real served cockpit remains PASS. The companion row_345_opv_a11y_served_identity_transform_control.json applies the status transform to an import-only test and must ESCAPE.
